run_inpaint_pipeline: run the FlaxStableDiffusionInpaintPipeline to generate inpainted images from a prompt, mask, and masked image using JAX
prepare_inputs_for_inpainting: prepare prompt IDs, processed masked images, and processed masks for inpainting using prepare_inputs
preprocess_image_for_inpainting: preprocess a PIL image to a normalized JAX array for use as input to the inpainting pipeline
preprocess_mask_for_inpainting: preprocess a PIL mask image to a normalized JAX array for use as input to the inpainting pipeline
run_safety_checker: run the NSFW safety checker on generated images and replace flagged images with black images
